Attach a citation to a design

Source: R/set_diagnosands.R
set_citation.Rd

Records how the design should be cited, as a utils::bibentry() built from the fields given, or as the text in citation. cite_design() returns it.

Usage

set_citation(
  design,
  title = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  description = "Unpublished research design declaration",
  citation = NULL
)

Arguments

design

(required) A design.

title

(optional) Title of the design.

author

(optional) Author or authors, as a string or a utils::person().

year

(optional) Year.

description

(optional) Note on the entry. Defaults to "Unpublished research design declaration".

citation

(optional) A ready-made citation, as a string or a bibentry, used in place of the fields above.

Value

design, with the citation stored in its citation attribute.

See also

Other citing a design: cite_design()

Examples

design <- declare_model(N = 10, Y = rnorm(N))
design <- set_citation(design, title = "Example", author = "Coppock",
                       year = 2026)
cite_design(design)
#> Coppock (2026). “Example.” Unpublished research design declaration.
